exposure: Misoprostol administered per rectum for postpartum hemorrhage
cohort: 80 women (40 vaginal deliveries and 40 cesarean sections) in a gynecology ward of a hospital in West Java
finding: The incidence of misoprostol side effects was high in both vaginal and cesarean delivery groups, with no significant difference in the incidence rates or side effect profiles between the two groups.
